releaseNotes: V898 fixes the reproduced multi-client AUTO LIVE startup interruption where the VPN instance observed an already-active P8=010001, then directly wrote 000000 and replayed Signal Tower Welcome/configuration ISDU before restoring the Running PDO.

The V897 REST startup trust handoff is repaired: first-connection generation zero is eliminated, the first process connection can retain a fresh pre-Connect REST decision, and the bounded trust age now covers the existing startup pipeline wait.

When the current connection is REST-verified same-device/no-remap and a required PDO is already non-zero, persisted AUTO LIVE warm-adopts startup continuity, holds first-scan PDO writes read-only, and skips Welcome/config neutralization. PdoOutputCoordinator remains the only PDO hardware writer.

en: Prevent a second AUTO LIVE client from neutralizing an already-running Signal Tower during trusted same-device startup.
Repair the connection-scoped REST startup trust handoff and keep its fail-closed identity behavior.
Warm-adopt retained active PDO continuity with a read-only first-scan output hold, without adding another PDO writer or heartbeat.
ko: 신뢰된 동일 장치 startup에서 두 번째 AUTO LIVE client가 이미 동작 중인 Signal Tower를 neutralize하지 않도록 수정했습니다.
connection-scoped REST startup trust 전달을 수정하고 기존 fail-closed identity 정책을 유지합니다.
별도 PDO writer/heartbeat 없이 기존 active PDO continuity를 warm adoption하고 첫 LIVE scan 동안 출력 write를 read-only hold합니다.
ja: 信頼済みの同一デバイス startup で、2つ目の AUTO LIVE client が稼働中の Signal Tower を neutralize しないよう修正しました。
connection-scoped REST startup trust の引き継ぎを修正し、既存の fail-closed identity 方針を維持します。
追加 PDO writer/heartbeat なしで既存 active PDO continuity を warm adoption します。
zh-CN: 修复可信同一设备启动时第二个 AUTO LIVE 客户端将正在运行的 Signal Tower 置零的问题。
修复 connection-scoped REST startup trust 传递，同时保留现有 fail-closed identity 策略。
无需新增 PDO writer/heartbeat，通过 warm adoption 保持已有 active PDO continuity。
de: Verhindert, dass ein zweiter AUTO-LIVE-Client beim vertrauenswürdigen Same-Device-Startup einen bereits laufenden Signal Tower neutralisiert.
Repariert die connection-scoped REST-Startup-Trust-Übergabe bei unverändertem Fail-Closed-Identity-Verhalten.
Übernimmt bestehende aktive PDO-Kontinuität per Warm Adoption ohne zusätzlichen PDO-Writer oder Heartbeat.
es: Evita que un segundo cliente AUTO LIVE neutralice una Signal Tower que ya está funcionando durante un arranque confiable del mismo dispositivo.
Corrige la transferencia connection-scoped de REST startup trust conservando el comportamiento identity fail-closed existente.
Adopta en caliente la continuidad PDO activa existente sin añadir otro writer PDO ni heartbeat.
